title: GAMMA.DIST: three separate figures - fitted cdf, held-out integer-a gate, and pdf
status_plain: GAMMA.DIST carries three figures that must be read together. The modern working corpus, which is fitted, gives 337 of 446. A genuinely held-out gate exists and is far larger: b26A, 4,100 fresh integer-a rows on the production path, giving 1,615 -- and its three blocks sum exactly to the catalogue's otherwise unlabelled "b26 1,615/4,100". And the pdf mode is a different, much worse measurement: 16.1% on 4,750 rows, a corpus ten times the size of the cdf corpus at about a fifth of the pass rate. Publishing 337/446 alone would overstate the surface.

reader_warning: 337/446 is the cdf mode on a fitted corpus. It may never render alone: the same function's pdf mode scores 16.1% on a corpus ten times larger, and the genuinely held-out figure is 1,615 of 4,100.
